input_plan.root_policy: Never edit raw bone/root track, skeleton, actor mesh scale, crop, keys, FPS or RateScale. Actual source/copy extracted root per model key audited before pool selection. On new Player InGame copies only: enable_root_motion=true, force_root_lock=true, root_lock from actual WeakAttack first sequence. Normalized flag and raw/root/rate stay unchanged; source options untouched. No extra .01 applied. Static true-root Air poses are intentionally preserved; no Root/Bip001 track transfer/repair. Native ability supplies owned force using adjustable temporary world-cm settings, duration from actual playing montage to HitLand/Getup; root mode Ignore only while own force.
